brLevelledPara.title: Scope
brLevelledPara.para: This data module records the business rule decisions taken for the A350X technical publications. It is the human-readable companion of the business rules exchange data module, which holds the same decisions in a form a validator can apply.
A decision recorded here is binding on every author, supplier and partner that delivers data for the programme. A request to change a decision is raised as a comment against this data module.

brDecision.para: All source data modules are authored in British English (en-GB) using Simplified Technical English, ASD-STE100 Issue 8. Translations are held as separate data modules with the same data module code and a different language code.

Applicability is expressed against the product attributes declared in the applicability cross-reference table. A data module must not state effectivity as free text in a paragraph when a computable statement is possible.
A display text is mandatory on every applicability statement, so that the printed publication reads correctly when the computable statement cannot be evaluated.
An illustration is referenced by its information control number only. The file name is never written into a data module, and an illustration is never embedded.

brLevelledPara.title: Delivery decisions
brLevelledPara.para: Data is delivered as a data dispatch note with the data modules, the publication modules and the illustrations it references. A delivery that does not resolve completely is rejected in full; partial acceptance is not used on this programme.
